$comment: Canonical Bytspot brand mark geometry, in the shared 120-unit viewBox. The mark is drawn independently on nine surfaces across two repos because iOS cannot read the SVG (asset-catalog rendering drops gradient fills in Release builds), so drift is structural rather than accidental. Geometry matches the supplied reference render of the landing screen. Both repos vendor this file byte-identically and gate against it: bytspot-beta/scripts/assert-brand-mark-geometry.mjs and bytspot/scripts/assert-brand-mark-geometry.mjs. Edit the geometry here, copy to the other repo, and both gates fail until every surface is updated.

unGated.reason: Flat 1024px raster, so it cannot be text-extracted. Measured against this contract and matching: gem 28x36 with 9.5 units of rise, opaque, no alpha. Re-measure it by colour bbox if the geometry ever changes, since no gate covers it.

colours.$comment: Measured off the 1024px app icon, which is the design of record: the rings and the gem are flat, not gradients. The code carried cyan->purple->cyan on the outer ring and purple->magenta on the gem, which the icon does not have.

retired.$comment: Removed from the mark only. The wordmark lockup on the flyers and the print sheet still runs cyan->purple->magenta by design, so these are not forbidden file-wide.
